claims.text: WikiChat achieves 97.3% factual accuracy in output generation by grounding on Wikipedia.
The language understanding and self-training approach proposed by Nie et al. reduces hallucination noise by over 50%.
In ChatGPT-generated research proposals, 69 out of 178 examined references lacked a Digital Object Identifier.
In ChatGPT-generated research proposals, 28 out of 178 examined references did not appear in Google searches or have an existing DOI.
Combining grammar-aware prompt engineering and formal methods mitigates LLM hallucinations by reducing prompt context ambiguity.
Grammar-aware prompt engineering incorporates linguistic rules and structures into AI prompting.
Formal methods provide a rule-based mathematical framework for systematic error detection and verification in LLM outputs.

evidence.description: WikiChat, which is grounded in Wikipedia, achieves 97.3% factual accuracy, outperforming fine-tuned models.
Nie et al. offered a strategy combining a language understanding module for data refinement with self-training iterations, reducing hallucination by over 50% of original unaligned noise.
In a study examining 178 references in ChatGPT-written research proposals, 69 did not have a Digital Object Identifier (DOI).
In the same evaluation of 178 ChatGPT references, 28 references did not appear in a Google search or have an existing DOI.
A combined integration of GAPE and FMs in LLMs provides an approach to address hallucinations by improving contextual understanding, improving language parsing, and resolving ambiguities.
GAPE is defined as a method of imbuing AI models with linguistic rules and structures to construct prompts with deliberate grammatical awareness.
Formal methods offer mathematical techniques for specifying and verifying software, giving AI developers a systematic framework for error detection and repair.

methodologies.name: Literature Review and Conceptual Framework Synthesis
methodologies.description: Qualitative synthesis and evaluation of scholarly literature, peer-reviewed articles, and industry reports across academic databases to examine LLM hallucination causes and propose a combined GAPE and FM conceptual framework.
conditions: Keyword searching across academic databases using terms like 'Grammar-aware prompting', 'LLM hallucinations', and 'Formal Methods'
Qualitative analysis of peer-reviewed journals, conference papers, and industry reports

limitations.text: Prior hallucination mitigation measures do not address the technical causes of hallucination arising from user prompt language ambiguities.
Adhering to strict grammar rules and formal methods can increase computational complexity and processing time during user prompt output generation.
The proposed combined integration of GAPE and formal methods is presented as a position paper argument based on literature synthesis rather than empirical benchmark experimentation.

future_work.text: Foster interdisciplinary collaboration among AI developers, ethicists, and linguists during LLM development.
Construct open-source, linguistically rigorous datasets incorporating ethics and linguistic principles for training LLMs.
Develop standardized evaluation frameworks and benchmarks for testing LLM language quality, parsing accuracy, and hallucination reduction efficacy.
Establish AI policy and legislative frameworks that advocate for formal language principles and grammar-aware prompt engineering in AI systems.
